# Stack Profile
<!-- Auto-generated by /critic-review. Edit to customize. -->

## Tech Stack
Next.js 15 (App Router, Turbopack), TypeScript 5.2, React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Raycast API, @propose/core (shared package), @vvo/tzdb (timezone data), Better Auth + Drizzle + Neon

## Analysis Scope
- Shared data package (`packages/core`) consumed by both web and Raycast
- React component state and dropdowns with grouping
- Raycast Form.Dropdown with sections and search keywords
- TypeScript interfaces shared across packages
- Build-time code generation scripts (tsx)
- Node.js script interop with pnpm workspaces

## Best Practices
- Shared `packages/core` types must be backward-compatible — both web and Raycast compile against the same interface
- `@vvo/tzdb` is a devDependency in core (script-only) — it must NOT be a runtime dependency
- Generated JSON is committed to the repo — the generation script is a dev tool, not a build step
- React keys must be unique in a list — when multiple items share the same IANA `value`, use a composite key
- Raycast `Form.Dropdown` `keywords` array is the only way to enable search on non-title text
- Tailwind 4 uses CSS-first config — no `tailwind.config.js` to extend; use `@theme` in CSS

## Analysis Format
- Core data: `packages/core/src/timezones-data.json`, `packages/core/src/timezones.ts`
- Core scripts: `packages/core/scripts/generate-timezones.ts`, `packages/core/scripts/us-cities.ts`
- Web component: `packages/web/components/TimezonePicker.tsx`
- Raycast: `packages/raycast/src/propose-times.tsx`
